data.name: Shadow Jump
data.description: At 6th level, when a shadow caller's shade inhabits her shadow, she can travel between shadows as per the shadowdancer's shadow jump ability. Each day, she can travel a total of 40 feet per spiritualist level in this way and, as with a shadowdancer, the distance is rounded to the nearest 10-foot increment.
